title: Hybrid AI-GUI Interaction Patterns
description: Framework for evaluating interfaces that combine conversational/AI and graphical elements. Addresses the transition period where both NL and GUI modalities must work together effectively.

context.why_hybrid: During the transition from GUI-first to intent-first interfaces, most systems will combine conversational AI with graphical elements. Effective hybrid design is critical.
context.key_challenge: Achieving coherence and fluidity between modalities while leveraging each modality's strengths

paradigm_shift.from: AI and GUI as separate interaction channels
paradigm_shift.to: Unified experience where modalities complement each other

pattern_categories.description: Moving between conversational and graphical modes

patterns.name: NL-to-GUI Handoff
patterns.description: User starts with natural language, system presents GUI for complex choices
when_to_use: Simple query leads to complex decision
patterns.example: User: 'Book a flight to NYC' → System presents calendar/time picker GUI

questions: Can user return to NL seamlessly?
Is the reason for mode switch clear?
what_to_look_for: Clear explanation of why GUI was presented
anti_patterns: GUI doesn't reflect prior NL input

patterns.name: GUI-to-NL Escalation
patterns.description: User hits limitation in GUI, escalates to NL for complex request
patterns.example: User in date picker realizes they need 'cheapest Tuesday in March' → switches to NL

questions: Does resolution reflect back to GUI?
what_to_look_for: Visible NL entry point in GUI
NL aware of current GUI state
anti_patterns: No obvious way to access NL from GUI
Results only in NL, can't use GUI to refine

patterns.name: NL Navigation of GUI
patterns.description: User navigates graphical interface using natural language
patterns.example: User says 'Show me only the overdue items' while looking at task list

questions: Can all GUI actions be achieved via NL?
Is NL navigation efficient compared to direct manipulation?
Is feedback appropriate for NL commands?
what_to_look_for: Faster than clicking for common actions
anti_patterns: NL can only do subset of GUI actions
No visual confirmation of NL actions

patterns.name: GUI Manifestation of NL
patterns.description: Conversational exchanges manifest as GUI elements
patterns.example: User asks 'Compare these three options' → NL response rendered as comparison table

questions: Can GUI elements be manipulated post-generation?
Is there parity between NL description and GUI reality?
Can users refine via either modality?
what_to_look_for: Rich visual rendering of NL outputs

patterns.name: Concurrent Input
patterns.description: User provides input through both modalities simultaneously
patterns.example: User drags selection box while saying 'Delete all of these except the red ones'

pattern_categories.description: System chooses optimal modality for each interaction

patterns.name: Complexity-Appropriate Modality
patterns.description: Simple tasks stay conversational, complex tasks get GUI

questions: Is modality selection appropriate to task complexity?
Does selection learn from user preference?
anti_patterns: Always shows GUI even for simple queries

patterns.name: Context-Appropriate Modality
patterns.description: Modality adapts to user context (hands-free, glanceable, etc.)

questions: Is core functionality preserved across modalities?

hybrid_heuristics.description: Usability heuristics specific to hybrid AI-GUI interfaces

heuristics.name: Modality Coherence
heuristics.description: Information and state are consistent across modalities

check_for: Same data shown in both modalities
Actions in one reflect in other
violations: GUI shows different state than NL describes
Actions in one modality don't reflect in other

severity_guide.critical: Users get different answers from different modalities
severity_guide.major: State changes don't sync between modalities

heuristics.name: Transition Fluidity
heuristics.description: Moving between modalities is smooth and contextual

severity_guide.critical: Users must restart task when switching

heuristics.name: Modality Parity
heuristics.description: Core tasks achievable in multiple modalities

violations: Critical function only in one modality

severity_guide.critical: Essential features inaccessible in some modalities
severity_guide.major: Secondary features missing in some modalities

heuristics.name: Selection Appropriateness
heuristics.description: Chosen modality matches task and context

violations: Forcing NL for visual comparison tasks

severity_guide.minor: Better modality available but current works

violations: No way to request different modality

severity_guide.critical: User cannot change modality at all

steps.name: Map Modality Usage
actions: Document which modalities each task uses

steps.name: Test Parallel Modalities
actions: Check GUI manifestation of NL outputs

steps.name: Evaluate Adaptive Selection
actions: Vary task complexity, check modality choice

metrics.name: transition_success_rate
metrics.description: Successful modality switches without context loss

metrics.name: modality_override_rate
metrics.description: How often users override system modality choice
metrics.interpretation: Lower = better selection, unless users don't know they can override

when_to_use: Evaluating systems with both chat and GUI
